# Ringfence

> A phone line for NEAR. A caller in a browser or on WhatsApp talks to one AI agent, and the agent acts from a NEAR wallet contract tied to the caller's phone number. The wallet contract holds the spending rules, so the agent can only ask it. A money packet is NEAR locked in a second contract; each person opens one share by saying the packet's words on a call. A caller can also ask for a top up from another chain ("top up my wallet with 2 dollars of SOL") and get a live NEAR Intents quote.

Site: https://ringfence.evalengine.ai
Source: https://github.com/ChromiaAgents/ringfence (MIT). AGENTS.md in the repository has the full version of this file.
Status: on NEAR mainnet since 10 November 2026, small amounts. The contracts are AI-reviewed, not audited.

## Pages

- https://ringfence.evalengine.ai/ : the call page
- https://ringfence.evalengine.ai/packet/demo : the open demo money packet. The words to say are shown on the page.
- https://ringfence.evalengine.ai/packet/family-1 : a money packet funded on mainnet by the Sputnik DAO ringfence-family.sputnik-dao.near. Its words are private.
- https://ringfence.evalengine.ai/proof : attestation results for the AI models. JSON: https://ringfence.evalengine.ai/api/proof
- https://ringfence.evalengine.ai/stats : usage numbers
- https://ringfence.evalengine.ai/wallet/bind : bind a phone number to your own NEAR account

## Call socket (typed text, no voice needed)

- wss://ringfence.evalengine.ai/ws/call
- Send: {"type":"text","text":"..."}
- Read: {"type":"agent","text":"..."} per sentence; {"type":"desk"} ends the turn. Binary frames are audio.
- A call about one money packet: /ws/call?packet=<id>&to=<account>. The id is in the Call link on /packet/demo.
- This is mainnet. A typed PIN after a prepared transfer sends real NEAR from the demo wallet. The right packet words with an account pay a real share.

## Commands (from a clone of the repository, Node 22 or newer, no keys)

- npm ci : about 15 s
- npm test : about 15 s, last line "<n> passed" (57 on 12 Nov 2026)
- npm run demo:check : about 15 s, last line "all steps passed"
- npm run verify:contracts : about 10 s, 3 blocks starting with "ok" (code on mainnet equals contracts/release/)
- npm run attest : about 10 s, "3/3 models fully verified"
- npm run verify:evidence : about 5 s, last line "15 of 15 transactions match" (reads the README evidence transactions from an archival RPC)
- npm run attack : about 2 s, last line "5 of 5 attacks blocked" (prompt-injection replay with a scripted model, in process)
- npm run live:check : 30 to 90 s, last line "5 of 5 checks passed" (types 5 lines into the call socket above; no PIN, nothing paid; replies come from a real model, so wording varies between runs)
- npm run topup:quote -- 10 SOL : about 5 s, a NEAR Intents 1Click dry quote (no deposit address) printed as JSON, last line "}"
- npm run dao:wallet -- family.sputnik-dao.near 15550104477 : about 2 s, prints Sputnik DAO proposals for a DAO-owned wallet; without WALLET_SECRET the last line is "REFUSED: WALLET_SECRET is not set. ..." (exit 1)
- cargo test in contracts/phone-wallet, contracts/factory, contracts/packets : about 7 minutes in total on a first run, each ends with "test result: ok."

## Contracts on NEAR mainnet

- ringfence-wallet.near : wallet factory (contracts/factory)
- <id>.ringfence-wallet.near : one phone wallet per phone number (contracts/phone-wallet, published once as a global contract)
- f18d3a55399e.ringfence-wallet.near : the website's demo wallet. View get_state: owner ringfence-custody.near, custodial, 1 NEAR per transfer, 3 NEAR per day, 60 second wait for a new recipient.
- packets.ringfence-wallet.near : money packets (contracts/packets)
- ringfence-agent.near : the account the server signs with. It holds one full-access key.

## Not built or not covered

- The spoken voice is made by Cartesia and is not attested. Chat, speech-to-text and image models run on NEAR AI Cloud in a TEE.
- The demo wallet is custodial. A wallet is owned by the user only after they bind their own NEAR account at /wallet/bind.
- Trezu is not used. A Sputnik DAO can own a phone wallet and fund a money packet (docs/dao-wallet.md, docs/dao-packet.md). The DAO-funded packet is on mainnet (README evidence rows 12 to 15). The DAO-owned wallet is not on mainnet yet.
- Top up from any chain through NEAR Intents 1Click: live deposit addresses when the caller gives a refund address (the server has TOPUP_LIVE=1), dry quotes otherwise. No swap is on mainnet yet.
- Staking for packets is not built.
- Spoken languages: English and Chinese.

## WhatsApp
- Built and supported: wallet by text, calls, the Approve card, money packets.
- Public number +60 11-7512 3486: waiting on Meta's business verification. Once approved, anyone can message or call it. This file will be updated.
- Until then: Meta's test number +1 555-144-4220, which only answers numbers Meta approved. The browser call at https://ringfence.evalengine.ai does the same on the shared demo wallet.
